label: team_0190_botan_01
text: Hasta la vistar... ☆[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0190_botan_02
text: The six of us thought up that catchphrase back\nwhen we created the team.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0190_botan_03
text: It’s so cringey it’s perfect, you know?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0190_botan_04
text: Anyway...about the LP thing. I thought I was\ngoing down big-time for hacking the League\r\nPoint system, but they’re letting me off easy...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0190_select_01
text: That’s great!

label: team_0190_select_02
text: What happened?

label: team_0190_botan_05
text:
The Pokémon League said they’ll waive my debt
if I do some volunteer engineering for them.\c
They even asked me to come work for them after
I graduate, if you can believe that.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0190_botan_06
text:
Director Clavell and that Geeta lady kept
complimenting me, like, a weird amount.\c
Apparently, I have “outstanding talent” or
something...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0190_botan_08
text: Sorry for calling you out here to meet like this.\nI’m still not so great with people face-to-face...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0190_botan_09
text: I never seem to find the right words, but, um...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0190_botan_10
text: Th-thank you...so much.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0190_botan_11
text: You saved Team Star—and my friends along\nwith it.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0190_botan_12
text: I know words won’t ever be enough to properly\nthank you for all you’ve done, so here...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0190_botan_13
text: I’m sure you’ll put this to good use.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0190_botan_14
text: And one more thing...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0190_botan_15
text: I want to repay the debt I owe you. If you ever\nthink of a way I can do that, just let me know.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0190_botan_16
text: I’m great with machines and hacking and stuff...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0190_botan_17
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So next time, I’ll be the one helping you,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0190_botan_18
text: Be seeing you, then. Hasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
